definitions.gloss: nearest; closest (especially of a station, store, or facility)
definitions.explanation: The one geographically closest to a given location, usually one's home, workplace, or current spot. Almost always used attributively before a noun, especially {駅|えき} (station).

examples.japanese: {最寄|もよ}りの{駅|えき}はどこですか。
{最寄|もよ}りのコンビニまで{歩|ある}いて{五分|ごふん}です。
examples.english: It's a five-minute walk to the nearest convenience store.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しくは{最寄|もよ}りの{窓口|まどぐち}までお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください。
examples.english: For details, please contact your nearest service counter.

notes:
Almost exclusively used attributively, in the pattern {最寄|もよ}りの + noun. Note the irregular reading もより (not さいき or さいよ). One of the most useful directions/location words for daily life in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最寄|もよ}りの{駅|えき}: nearest station
- {最寄|もよ}りのコンビニ: nearest convenience store
- {最寄|もよ}りの{店舗|てんぽ}: nearest store/branch
- {最寄|もよ}りの{交番|こうばん}: nearest police box
- {最寄|もよ}り{駅|えき}: home station; nearest station (as a noun compound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一番|いちばん}{近|ちか}い: the closest — more conversational, can describe distance generally
- {近|ちか}くの: nearby — looser; doesn't specifically mean the nearest one
